questions.q: Where do you land after Navigator › General Accounting?
options: The General Accounting Dashboard, built from infolets
questions.explain: General Accounting opens on the dashboard, a landing page of infolets you click into for detail.

questions.q: Which work area would you use to create and post a manual journal?
questions.explain: The Journals work area is where manual journals are created, managed, approved, and posted.

questions.q: Which work area houses the month-end close checklist, revaluation, and translation?
questions.explain: Period Close is the dedicated work area for the month-end close process, including revaluation and translation.

options: A small dashboard summary tile you click to drill into detail
A synonym for a scheduled process
questions.explain: Infolets are the small summary tiles that make up the General Accounting Dashboard.

questions.q: Where do longer-running jobs like posting, journal import, and allocations actually execute and get monitored?
options: Directly inside the Create Journal screen
questions.explain: Scheduled Processes is where submitted jobs run and are monitored to completion, rather than finishing instantly on screen.
